docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Bentley’s historical account of Hindu astronomy, the Sūrya Siddhānta and the other Siddhāntas, the lunar mansions and the chronology of the Purāṇas, with his controversial dating of the texts (Calcutta, 1825). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Digitised by Google from a copy in Harvard University; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: A historical view of the Hindu astronomy, from the earliest dawn of science in India to the present time. In two parts. Part I. The ancient astronomy. Part II. The modern astronomy, with an explanation of the apparent cause of its introduction, and the various impositions that followed. To which are added, I. Hindu tables of equations. II. Remarks on the Chinese astronomy. III. Translations of certain hieroglyphics, called the Zodiacs of Dendera · Bentley, John · 1825, 357 scanned pages. Published 1825; John Bentley died 1824; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
